correctness.rationale: The exact identity \(Q=ab(1-\operatorname{Ncut})/(2m^2)\) follows directly from the standard bipartition formulas. The exhaustive exact-rational verifier checks all connected labeled simple graphs through \(6\) vertices and every bipartition with at least two vertices per side and \(Q>0\). It proves zero strict reversals through \(5\), \(420\) labeled strict reversals at \(6\), and exactly two classes after canonicalization under vertex relabeling and partition symmetries.

value.rationale: Modularity and normalized cut are standard community-quality objectives with different balance behavior. The structural identity explains exactly why equal-volume comparisons agree, while the sharp six-vertex classification shows the smallest community-like case where balance changes overturn the choice. This gives a natural diagnostic benchmark for comparing community-detection objectives.
